sentences.text: Task 3. Monica is hosting a discussion on a cat called Mr Seuss, who has become a popular Internet influencer.
With Monica are Estella Webber, owner of the cat, and Max Hoy, chair of the Hong Kong Cat Shelter.
delta. Listen to the conversation and make notes in the note sheet below.
Please note that you do not need to answer incomplete sentences.
You now have 30 seconds to study the task.
At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers.
Welcome Astella, an internet sensation Mr Seuss.
Say hello Mr Seuss.
Look he’s smiling.
What's that Mr Seuss?
He says he loves your show.
Thank you Mr Seuss.
And welcome Max from the Hong Kong Cat Shelter.
Nice to meet you Monica, Estella.
Mr Seuss. Now I have to say I don’t think we've ever had as big a star as Mr Seuss.
on our show, so this is a great honor.
Just in case you don’t know Mr Seuss, Mr Seuss has 4 .1 million followers on YouTube.
4 .1 2 million as of yesterday actually.
I's then corrected, sorry Mr Seuss.
Getting even more popular by the day.
And he is considered more influential than the TV News according to a recent survey.
That's right. More people watch Mr Seuss than they watch the TV news every day.
That survey was very recent too, only a few days ago.
Then I guess the big question is why?
I mean he’s cute but how come he’s such a huge success.
Well, Mr Seuss is famous for three things.
First is that Mr Seuss simply loves dressing up as superheroes.
heroes. He’s dressed up as Batman, Superman, Iron Man, all the superheroes.
I’m not sure Mr Seuss loves dressing up as superheroes.
Yes, he does actually!
And I suppose he dances too?
Don’t be silly.
As if Mr Seuss would dance!
He’s far more talented than that.
Mr
Seuss And the other thing that makes him an internet sensation is that Mr Seuss gets gifts from all over the world.
So, he’s popular for getting gifts?
Well, no. It’s not just getting the gifts.
He’s famous for opening the gifts.
His viewers love to watch Mr Seuss open the gifts that people send him.
He got a cat sized car last week.
Did you see that one?
No, I think I missed it.
That's fascinating Astella, But how do you train Mr Seuss to do things for these videos?
On cats difficult to train?
There are two main methods I use to train my cat.
The first method is to place food rewards at the place where I want him to go.
When Mr Seuss goes to that certain spot, I give him a little food treat.
Interesting. So, what’s the other method?
I repeat the action I want Mr Seuss to perform, but here’s the important part.
I keep each session short.
Just to check that our viewers got that.
You repeat the action you want him to do but only for a short period each time.
Why only a short period?
Cats have a very short attention span.
If you try to get them to repeat in action for too long the cat will lose interest.
Now Max, you've been studying this internet cat influencer phenomenon and you've discovered that cat videos are much more popular than dog videos on YouTube.
Why is that?
Well, our research has shown that people prefer watching cat videos for two reasons.
The first is that cats have lives that are more mysterious than dogs.
That's so true!
Mr Seuss's life is a complete mystery to me.
When I'm out of the flat, he gets up to all kinds of things.
I’m so curious about what he does that I have cameras all over the house to record what he's doing when I’m not there.
there, But even.
then, he disappears.
He’s a real man of mystery.
And the second is that cat behaviour is less predictable than dog behaviour.
What cats do is more surprising because of this.
Oh gosh yes.
Dogs are so boringly predictable.
I’m never surprised by what a dog does.
Now, Max, you have expressed concern about owners like Estella here who used their cats for monetary gain on the Internet.
Yes, I'm not saying that what Estella is doing does not have benefits for cats.
For instance, our research has shown Internet cat influences like Mr Seuss create positive feelings in their viewers.
Mr Seuss makes all his viewers feel positive.
He’s a very positive cat.
Did your research also show that Internet cats cats encourage people to adopt stray cats?
Yes, our research did show that adoption of stray cats is linked to Internet cat influencers.
This is definitely a good thing for stray cats.
But we do have concerns, Such us?
Our main concern is with cat owners who abandoned their cat once their cat stops being popular or making money.
Oh, that’s awful.
I would never abandon Mr Seuss.
Even if he became unpopular I would always keep him.
I’m trying to imagine what might make a cat unpopular.
Maybe some offensive tweet about birds?
